description:
## Functional specifications and files
Extend Browsing command allowlist/schema/output in lib/zaq/agent/tools/web/browsing.ex; keep command mechanics there and isolate cohesive private screenshot orchestration if needed without introducing a second browser execution path. Add screenshot (PNG, current viewport in v1; no extra capture-mode expansion). Read current screenshot destination for each request, validate before capture, and resolve final HTTP(S) page URL in the same existing session. Reject blank/non-web current pages clearly.

## Capture and storage contract
Pinned agent-browser screenshot returns only a file path, including JSON output; internal base64 is not exposed. Use exactly one application-controlled, uniquely named temporary capture file; no extra copy, arbitrary model path, new artifact registry or materialization handler. Read bounded PNG content and call the reusable CreateDocument Action internally (base64 content + image/png), retaining trusted actor context. Find/create a hostname-named subfolder beneath the configured destination; resolve existing canonical folder ID and tolerate concurrent create/exists safely without overwriting unrelated items. Use actual final URL hostname and pathname, not user-supplied URL/page title. Name: <page-slug>--<UTC-timestamp>--<collision-resistant-random-id>.png; root pathname -> home, nested pathname -> sanitized bounded slug, no query/fragment/userinfo in filename. Preserve safe hostname representation, including edge cases, and never permit traversal. Example www.zaq.ai/sme--20260929T173049123Z--7c91a3e802b645d19f408a76.png. Choose name explicitly; CLI default lacks page identity.

## Results, failures and cleanup
Only report success after destination upload succeeds; return command plus compact output and optional canonical document Record/available location metadata. Never return image bytes to LLM or expose local paths. Missing destination, unreadable capture, command timeout, oversize file and upload/authorization failure yield explicit bounded errors. Cleanup the one owned temp file in guaranteed completion/failure handling. Do not delete user/provider files. Do not automatically repeat uncertain uploads; retry can create another uniquely named capture. Changes to configured destination affect next capture; existing screenshots are not relocated.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Tests first in browsing tests and focused screenshot tests: PNG content integrity through validated CreateDocument; viewport capture; final redirect hostname/path naming; home/nested/Unicode/long/malformed path cases; normalization/traversal and collision properties; two captures same timestamp; folder reuse and concurrent creation; destination/config/ACL failures; no implicit bypass; temp cleanup on every exit; empty/missing/oversize file; command or storage failure cannot claim success; compact output with Record. Reuse existing opt-in real browser fixture harness (related zaq-5j6), not a new harness. Clock/random/CLI/provider effects resolved at public boundary with production seams; keep internal services real, mock external CLI/provider only.

## Action reuse and docs
Extend Browsing and reuse validated CreateDocument/list datasource operations; generic upload remains in its existing owner, browser owns capture orchestration, no LLM base64 roundtrip. Read Agent/Channels/System config owners. Update Action description/output docs and relevant Agent/System configuration service docs, including filenames, missing-destination errors, binary handling and cleanup.

## Execution constraints and policies
Planning only; do not mark complete without implementation evidence. Future implementation uses a new branch in the current worktree, not another worktree; do not commit/push without authorization. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Read each affected module @moduledoc and relevant service owner before editing. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle rather than inventing alternate gates. Preserve existing assertions. New feature E2E authoring is deferred until the separate human approval issue closes.
